title: Countably many C¹ graph charts cover the regular part of a level set of a C¹ function on an open subset of ℝ^{n+1}
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} open, F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ of class C¹ and t ∈ ℝ. Then there are, for k ∈ ℕ, open sets D_k ⊆ ℝⁿ, maps Λ_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+1}, points c_k ∈ ℝⁿ and reals ρ_k such that: Λ_k is C¹ on D_k and injective on D_k; for every z ∈ D_k, Λ_k(z) ∈ W, F(Λ_k(z)) = t, DΛ_k(z) is injective and DΛ_k(z)(ℝⁿ) = ker DF(Λ_k(z)); B̄_{ρ_k}(c_k) ⊆ D_k; and every y ∈ W with DF(y) ≠ 0 and F(y) = t equals Λ_k(z) for some k and some z in the open ball B_{ρ_k}(c_k).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ), IsOpen W → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (D : ℕ → Set (Euclid n)) (Λ : ℕ → Euclid n → Euclid (n + 1)) (c : ℕ → Euclid n) (ρ : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, IsOpen (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Λ k) (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, InjOn (Λ k) (D k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ z ∈ D k, Λ k z ∈ W ∧ F (Λ k z) = t ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ (Λ k) z) ∧ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Λ k) z : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)) = LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ F (Λ k z) : Euclid (n + 1) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ)) ∧ (∀ k, closedBall (c k) (ρ k) ⊆ D k) ∧ ∀ y ∈ W, fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0 → F y = t → ∃ k, ∃ z ∈ ball (c k) (ρ k), Λ k z = y
